# getjinai.com

> getjinai.com handles sales for Jin AI and is operated by Jin AI. Jin AI is the GTM engineer agent for B2B SaaS marketing teams. It learns how a team's best marketers run campaigns, such as events, webinars and product launches, and turns that work into agentic workflows the whole team can run. Capture is opt-in for each marketer, marketers review and edit what Jin learns, and managers see workflows and results, not screens. Customer data is not used to train AI models. The official site is https://jinai.md/.

## Pages

- [Get Jin AI | The GTM Engineer Agent for B2B SaaS Marketing Teams](https://getjinai.com/): Shop by campaign type, compare ways to start, and set up your first campaign workflow.
- [Jin AI for Teams: Product Details, Specifications, and Q&A | getjinai](https://getjinai.com/jin-ai-for-teams/): Product details, admin controls, privacy, and answers to common questions.
- [Jin AI by Campaign and Role](https://getjinai.com/solutions/): Events, webinars, product launches, ABM, nurture, content
- [Services](https://getjinai.com/services/): Campaign selection, context setup, capture review, results review, pilot
- [Support](https://getjinai.com/support/): Contact, security and privacy, FAQ

## Key facts

- Category: GTM engineer agent for B2B SaaS marketing teams
- How it works: unify the marketing context (brand guidelines, product catalog, messaging, past campaigns); capture how each marketer works across tools on their desktop; turn that work into agentic campaign workflows; roll out the best version to the whole team
- Example workflow: an event (target accounts, demand gen, venue, speakers, content, follow-up)
- Trust: opt-in capture per marketer; marketers see and edit what Jin learns; managers see workflows and results, not screens; each company's data kept separate
- How to start: one campaign workflow your team already runs (pilot)
- Demo and contact: https://jinai.md/ (hello@jinai.md)
